description:
As a registered user, I want to log in to the application using my email address and password so that I can access my personal dashboard and perform authorized actions.

Login page UI requirements:
- Email address input field (type='email', required)
- Password input field (type='password', masked, required)
- 'Show/Hide Password' toggle button
- 'Remember Me' checkbox (unchecked by default)
- 'Forgot Password?' link that redirects to /password-reset
- 'Login' submit button (disabled until both fields are non-empty)
- Loading spinner shown during authentication
- Social login buttons: 'Continue with Google', 'Continue with Microsoft'

Authentication rules:
- Email must match standard RFC 5322 format
- Password: minimum 8 characters, maximum 128 characters
- Passwords are case-sensitive
- Trim leading/trailing whitespace from email before validation; do NOT trim password
- Lock account after 5 consecutive failed attempts within a 15-minute window
- Implement rate limiting: max 10 login requests per minute per IP address
- All login traffic must occur over HTTPS (TLS 1.2+); redirect HTTP to HTTPS
- Return generic error message — never reveal whether the email exists

Session management:
- 'Remember Me' checked: persist session for 30 days via HTTP-only, Secure, SameSite=Strict JWT cookie
- 'Remember Me' unchecked: session expires after 30 minutes of inactivity
- On successful login, redirect to the page the user originally requested (returnUrl), defaulting to /dashboard
- Invalidate any existing session tokens on new login
- Multi-device support: a new login does NOT invalidate sessions on other devices
acceptance_criteria: User logs in successfully with valid registered email and correct password and is redirected to /dashboard
User is redirected to the originally requested URL (returnUrl) after successful login
System displays 'Invalid email or password. Please try again.' for wrong credentials without revealing which field is incorrect
Login button is disabled until both email and password fields contain at least one character
Email field rejects input that is not a valid email format and shows inline validation error 'Please enter a valid email address'
Password field masks characters; Show/Hide toggle reveals and hides the password text
Account is locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within 15 minutes; subsequent attempts show 'Your account has been locked. Please contact support or wait 15 minutes.'
Failed attempt counter resets to 0 on a successful login
Selecting 'Remember Me' keeps the user logged in for 30 days via a secure HTTP-only cookie
Without 'Remember Me', the session expires after 30 minutes of inactivity and the user is redirected to /login
Navigating to the app over HTTP redirects to HTTPS
A loading spinner is shown from the moment the user clicks Login until the response is received
Login page and all auth endpoints respond within 2 seconds under normal load
Rate limiter blocks IPs sending more than 10 login requests per minute; returns HTTP 429
Login works correctly on Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari on both desktop and mobile viewports (320 px wide and above)
Keyboard navigation: all form elements are reachable via Tab; form submits on Enter
Screen-reader accessible: all inputs have associated labels; error messages are announced via aria-live

subtasks.summary: Implement email + password validation on login form
Implement account lockout after 5 failed attempts
Implement Remember Me / session expiry logic

attachments.content:
Technical Specifications — Login Module v2.1

Email validation: RFC 5322; strip leading/trailing whitespace before check
Password constraints: min 8 chars, max 128 chars, case-sensitive, no whitespace trimming
Hashing algorithm: bcrypt with cost factor 12
Failed attempt tracking: Redis counter keyed by (email + IP); TTL 15 minutes; incremented on every 401
Account lockout: counter >= 5 → lock flag set in DB; unlock requires support action OR 15-min TTL expiry
JWT: RS256 signed, 15-minute access token + 30-day refresh token (Remember Me) or 30-minute refresh (no Remember Me)
Cookie flags: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict
Session storage: access token in memory only (never localStorage); refresh token in HTTP-only cookie
HTTPS: enforce via HSTS header (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains)
Rate limiting: Nginx limit_req_zone, 10 r/m per IP; returns 429 with Retry-After header
Error messages: never differentiate between unknown email and wrong password
ReturnUrl handling: validate returnUrl against allowlist of internal paths; reject absolute URLs to prevent open redirect
MFA: out of scope for this story
